commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Protect conduct, even with pain, letting none of it perish. Examine all kinds of righteousness, ask with a settled mind which helps in both worlds, and conduct is the one that proves your help. These two couplets tell the excellence of conduct.
